completions.note: Member completion at the searchText token (owner ItemCollectionState). Watches all ItemCollectionState members including getters and methods; absences guard against parent-object members (CatalogState.items/selection), repeat locals, and unrelated members leaking in. VERDICT (2026-07-07): all ten class members present with accurate type details, parent-object members and locals correctly absent, and the candidate count matches the class surface exactly.

Root-scope completion inside the badge repeat. The local badge must be visible; the sibling repeat's local item must NOT be (different template controller scope). Scope-visibility territory predicted to mint new clusters. VERDICT (2026-07-07): the local and the view-model root are both visible and the sibling repeat local is correctly scoped out. The additional variable-kind candidates are repeat contextuals, which belong here.

Root-scope completion outside any repeat (if.bind on line 3). Neither repeat local may be visible here. Comparable scope check to root-scope-in-repeat. VERDICT (2026-07-07): locals correctly invisible outside their controller scope. Offering only proven scope entries at root position is a defensible austerity (false positives are worse); whether $this/$parent/globals should be offered is a product question, not a wrongness.

Element tag completion. item-card is admitted via the route component's dependency graph; loose-picklist/ticket-editor exist only in a different fixture and must not leak across app worlds. Resource-admission territory. VERDICT (2026-07-07): dependency-admitted element present, cross-app-world resources absent.
